prompt: Create three independent files in the current working directory: mathops.py with add(a,b) and mul(a,b); strops.py with shout(s) returning uppercase plus '!' and slug(s) lowercasing and replacing spaces with hyphens; and README.md with a table of all four functions. Verify with python that add(2,3)==5 and shout('hi')=='HI!'. Reply with the word DONE when all three files exist and both checks pass.

Create wordcount.py exposing count_words(text) -> dict mapping each lowercased word to its count, plus a __main__ block that counts a string given on argv. Then create test_wordcount.py with at least three pytest tests covering the empty string, repeated words, and mixed case. Run pytest and report the result. Reply with the word DONE when the tests pass.

Create legacy.py containing a single 40-line function that validates an email, normalizes a phone number, and formats a name. Then split it into three separate functions in a new file cleaned.py, write a docstring for each, and create MIGRATION.md explaining the split. Reply with the word DONE when all three files exist.

Create sample.csv with 10 rows of id,name,score. Then create load.py that reads it into a list of dicts, stats.py that computes mean/median/max score, and report.py that prints a formatted summary. Run report.py and show its output. Reply with the word DONE when it runs cleanly.
